messages:
linda: Quick kitchen note — there are 2 sushi boxes on the top fridge shelf labeled 'sam' (please claim by 11:30) and a small pile of mystery muffins in Tupperware with no name. Also planning a casual 'salad swap' this Thursday at 12:30 — sign up below (write name + what you bring).

signup: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-salad-swap

sam: omg that's mine, totally forgot to put mine in my bag. will grab before 11:15, sorry! :grimacing:

maya: i'll bring a lemon-tahini dressing for the swap. signed the sheet.

aj: put me down for quinoa + roasted beet salad. also quick poll — plant milk preference? almond, oat, soy? i'm team oat.

rob: if sushi ends up unclaimed i can take it to the curb compost box after lunch (don't want it sitting all day). also i have an extra shallow container for anyone who wants to transport leftovers.

pantry-bot: Inventory check: almond milk = 2 cartons, oat milk = 1 carton, soy milk = 0. Coffee beans: medium roast low (approx 150g). To request restock, run `/restock pantry` or react with :package:.

linda: thanks! aj — let's do a quick emoji poll: react with :almond: for almond, :oat: for oat, :soy: for soy (i made up the emojis lol). i'll order a spare oat carton if that's the winner.

sam: :oat: — also the mystery muffins one is labeled 'leftovers from startup demo' so maybe not our bakery. anyone else take a peek? :shrug:

maya: checked — two blueberry, one raspberry. no note. i left a sticky that says "free — please take by 2pm".

aj: :oat: (:oat:), and i'll toss my dressing in the fridge tag as `maya - dressing` so it's easy to find.

rob: also put a tiny sign on the veggie drawer: "Salad Swap Thursday 12:30" so walk-bys see it.

linda: nice — thanks team. i'll handle ordering one oat milk and a coffee bag if enough people react. if anyone wants to claim the sushi after 11:30 ping me and i'll mark it 'claimed by'. :coffee:

pantry-bot: Restock request queued: oat milk x1, coffee beans x1. ETA 2 business days.

sam: claimed and in my bag 11:10 — mystery solved. :sushi:

maya: victory muffins remain. i'll cut them into shareable slices at 2pm.

aj: perfect — see you at the swap. :salad:
